name: rosetta-inverted-index
code:
use default

let documents = [
    "it is what it is",
    "what is done is done",
    "what is done is what is done"
]

let index = MAP[string, SET[int]]()
let number mut = 0

for document in documents do
    for word in document.split([' ']) do
        if !index.contains_key(word) then
            index[word] = SET[int]()
        fi

        index[word].add(number)
    od

    number = number + 1
od

for term in ["what", "is", "done", "absent"] do
    let hits = if index.contains_key(term)
        then index[term] |> sort() |> map(n => "{n}") |> join(", ")
        else ""
        fi

    write_line("{term}: {hits}")
od
